app TypedCalendarDurations
Given
 Span { day:date=date("2028-02-28"), elapsed:duration=1ms, days:date[], durations:duration[], seedDays:date[]=[date("2028-02-28")], seedDurations:duration[]=[1ms,1s], maybeDay:date?, maybeElapsed:duration?, maybeDays:date[]?, maybeDurations:duration[]? }
 policy Span read=public
When
 crud Span by=members fields=day,elapsed,days,durations,seedDays,seedDurations,maybeDay,maybeElapsed,maybeDays,maybeDurations
 ## Calendar arithmetic crosses leap day; durations remain exact integer milliseconds.
 scenario advance(span:Span,day:date,delta:duration,days:date[],durations:duration[],accept:bool) -> date by=members
  do
   require day>=span.day and all(days as value,value>=day)
   set span {day=add_days(day,1),elapsed=span.elapsed+delta+sum(durations)+sum(span.seedDurations),days=days,durations=durations}
   require span.day>day
   require accept
   return span.day
 scenario elapsed(span:Span) -> duration by=members
  do return span.elapsed
 scenario days(span:Span) -> date[] by=members
  do
   require all(span.days as value,value>=date("0001-01-01"))
   return span.days
 scenario durations(span:Span) -> duration[] by=members
  do return [sum(span.durations),span.elapsed]
 ## Non-null inputs write nullable fields; omitted nullable inputs clear them.
 scenario optional(span:Span,day:date?,elapsed:duration?,days:date[]?,durations:duration[]?) -> duration? by=members
  do
   set span {maybeDay=day,maybeElapsed=elapsed,maybeDays=days,maybeDurations=durations}
   return span.maybeElapsed
 scenario maybeDay(span:Span) -> date? by=members
  do return span.maybeDay
 scenario maybeElapsed(span:Span) -> duration? by=members
  do return span.maybeElapsed
 scenario maybeDays(span:Span) -> date[]? by=members
  do return span.maybeDays
 scenario maybeDurations(span:Span) -> duration[]? by=members
  do return span.maybeDurations
 ## Original date and millisecond defaults remain wire receipt values.
 scenario defaults(day:date=date("2028-02-28"),delta:duration=1s,days:date[]=[date("2028-02-28")],durations:duration[]=[1ms,1s]) -> duration by=members
  do
   require add_days(day,1)==date("2028-02-29") and all(days as value,value==day)
   return delta+sum(durations)
Then
